info.title: roam — build .NET on any host, run on any host, debug from anywhere.
info.description: Dev-loop orchestrator for .NET workflows where the machine that edits the code, the machine that compiles it, and the machine that runs it are three different computers. Edit locally, `dotnet publish` to a build host, sync via SFTP to a target, and attach a `coreclr` debugger — all through one `roamfile.yaml`. Install with `dotnet tool install -g Roam.Cli`.

commands.description: Fetch a diagnostics bundle (logs, crash dumps) from the target.

options.description: Bundle output dir (default: .roam/diag/<profile>/<run-id>).

options.description: Capture the logs tier (default when no tier flag is given).

options.name: --since
options.description: journald window for the unit capture (e.g. '1 hour ago').

options.name: --json

options.name: --keep-remote

Leave any target-side scratch in place (trace/bundled tier).
